p3-paaralan.title: Unang Araw sa Paaralan
p3-paaralan.text: Unang araw ni Lea sa paaralan. Dala niya ang bagong lapis at kuwaderno. Bumati si Titser Ana, "Magandang umaga!" Umupo si Lea sa tabi ni Rey. Nagbahagi si Lea ng krayola kay Rey. Masaya si Lea pag-uwi.

p3-kalabaw.title: Ang Kalabaw ni Tatay
p3-kalabaw.text: May kalabaw si Tatay. Ang pangalan nito ay Kalog. Tuwing umaga, tumutulong si Kalog sa bukid. Sa tanghali, naliligo ito sa putikan. Gustong-gusto ni Kalog ang damo. Mahal ni Nilo si Kalog.

p4-lapis.title: Ang Nawawalang Lapis
p4-lapis.text: Isang umaga, hindi makita ni Rosa ang kanyang lapis. Hinanap niya ito sa kanyang bag at sa ilalim ng upuan. Malungkot siya dahil may pagsusulit sila. Lumapit si Ben at sinabing, "Hiramin mo muna ang lapis ko." Natuwa si Rosa at nagpasalamat. Pagkatapos ng klase, nakita ni Rosa ang lapis niya sa loob ng kanyang kuwaderno. Ibinalik niya ang lapis ni Ben at binigyan pa niya ito ng kendi.

p4-hugas.title: Ang Paghuhugas ng Kamay
p4-hugas.text: Mahalaga ang paghuhugas ng kamay. Ang maruming kamay ay may mikrobyo na nagdudulot ng sakit. Maghugas ng kamay bago kumain at pagkatapos gumamit ng banyo. Gumamit ng sabon at malinis na tubig. Kuskusin ang mga kamay habang nagbibilang hanggang dalawampu. Banlawan at patuyuin gamit ang malinis na tuwalya. Sa ganitong paraan, malusog at ligtas tayo.

p5-market.title: Saturday at the Market
p5-market.text: On Saturday, Ana went to the market with her father. The market was busy and loud. They bought fish, rice and green vegetables. Ana saw a stall full of bright red tomatoes, so Father bought a kilo. On the way out, Ana saw an old woman drop her bag of oranges. The oranges rolled everywhere! Ana quickly helped her pick them up. The woman smiled and gave Ana one sweet orange. At home, Ana told Mother about the busy market and the kind woman. "I want to go again next Saturday," she said.

p5-program.title: The School Program
p5-program.text: The Grade 1 class practiced a dance for the school program. Every afternoon, Teacher Joy played the music, and the children practiced the steps. Leo always forgot the third step. He felt worried. His friend Mara said, "Watch my feet, and count with me." They practiced together every day. On the day of the program, the class wore red and yellow costumes. When the music started, Leo counted softly and did every step right. The audience clapped loudly. Leo smiled and hugged Mara.
